svg.title: Automated minus reference counts on the gold standard: protocol change
svg.desc: Difference plot of automated minus reference counts against the reference count for every gold row with an asserted value. Identity misses and matched rows without an automated count are evaluated as zero and drawn in their own styles.
svg.metadata: Arm baseline: 20260906_model12_grok43, locked 2026-09-06T14:00:54.868017+00:00 Arm candidate: 20260906_model12_grok43_astra_clinical_verified, locked 2026-09-06T16:27:47.121771+00:00 Evaluation rule: difference = automated count minus reference count for every gold row with an asserted value; an identity miss or a matched row without an automated count is evaluated as 0 (the full reference count is the error) Axes: reference 0..550 (square root); difference ±110 (signed square root) Marker radius is 8 + 2*sqrt(rows), capped at 28 viewBox units
